items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1966-03-09
items.q: We had a fellow by the name of Willie Phillip. You ever heard of him, a trumpet player?

ctx.x: I was going to ask about your very first band that you played in, your very first job. Do you remember the first time you ever got paid for playing, let's say?

Yeah, I remember the first time I got paid. I played with these boys here. No, not these boys, the Merit band, M-E-R-I-T. Yeah, I don't know them. Well you don't know them. Well that's the first band I played with. We played a little party on very, between Seminole, right back in my house, between Seminole and Nannick. All right, well, first time, me, Green, I didn't know, you know what I mean? We get there and we tune up. We had a fellow by the name of Willie Phillip. You ever heard of him, a trumpet player?
